test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
What would be the symbol on the opposite side of '@' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c51c866f84a3d760ef529ce760bc0ece713397bdaa36b95c0e3bb15633955787.png]
solution:
Opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below methods: -

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surface are touched by side or by corners.

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

Below are the opposite surfaces: -

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d20eb499bb224a77d7f8fb7e0e1bf44543c46827d12e4d3dcdb14fc15b25609.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b0319b3cbb15993df23c82b06b374d1ec7cabfccb69a215fb0c6399859c9708.png] 

Here, we can see that the opposite side of '@' is '*'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"*"**.
